## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Equities strong but risk signals mixed — SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +9.84%) ↑ rising and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +15.82%) ↑ rising, while VXX in RECOVERY (1W: +1.34% | 1M: -15.26%) ↑ rising and HYG/LQD in CORRECTION (HYG (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +0.80%) → flat) produce offsetting confirmations.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit conditions neutral: HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +0.80%) → flat and LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.12%) → flat. Volatility mixed: VXX RECOVERY (1W: +1.34% | 1M: -15.26%) ↑ rising but 1M downtrend shows lower structural fear.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral: UUP BELOW TREND (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -1.19%) → flat and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -1.04%) → flat, implying modestly easier conditions but no clear directional push.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Tech leadership: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +21.09%) ↑ rising and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +40.29%) ↑ rising; Energy mixed but firm: XLE RECOVERY (1W: +3.02% | 1M: -0.39%) ↑ rising. Style: Growth/Momentum showing strength versus Value.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US and EM both active: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +9.84%) ↑ rising while EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +14.52%) ↑ rising and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +2.64%) → flat, indicating broad participation beyond the US.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation healthy: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.96% | 1M: +17.11%) ↑ rising and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +11.97%) ↑ rising; ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +11.31%) ↑ rising supports risk-on positioning within niches.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Industrial metals supportive: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +5.92%) → flat; base commodities and oil stronger while Gold showing weakness: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.86% | 1M: -2.19%) → flat.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy overall firmer: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.42%) ↑ rising while XLE RECOVERY (1W: +3.02% | 1M: -0.39%) ↑ rising; natural gas volatile with UNG RECOVERY (1W: +3.00% | 1M: -6.42%) ↑ rising.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Broad equities (SPY, QQQ, XLK) ABOVE TREND with sector breadth 6/11 positive. DIVERGENCE: XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +3.43%) and VXX RECOVERY (1W: +1.34% | 1M: -15.26%) are minor divergences — no major multi-core breakdown.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor growth/momentum ETFs showing strength (XLK (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +21.09%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +40.29%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to duration-sensitive bonds (TLT (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -1.04%) BELOW TREND); monitor XLF and GLD for potential rotation or safe-haven reflows.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Technology — XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +21.09%) and Semis SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +40.29%).  
BEARISH: Healthcare — XLV RECOVERY (1W: +1.02% | 1M: -0.67%) and Financials — XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +3.43%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Brent/BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.42%) and Copper/CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +5.92%).  
BEARISH: Gold/GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.86% | 1M: -2.19%) and Silver/SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -0.44% | 1M: -0.27%).

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX 20 (volatility complacency threshold); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health watchpoint); XLK/XLF ratio ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot); SPY 1M momentum support consistent with ABOVE TREND (SPY (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +9.84%)).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive.  
Technology and semiconductors showing relative strength (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +21.09%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +40.29%)).  
Key risk: minor divergences in Financials and volatility (XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +3.43%), VXX RECOVERY (1W: +1.34% | 1M: -15.26%)) — monitor for rotation.
